legal_name: MULTICHEM SPECIALITIES PRIVATE LIMITED (as claimed; not independently verified in MCA/registry records)
note: Registry verification NOT completed - data unavailable, not negative. Tool budget (10 calls) exhausted without a single successful registry lookup: DuckDuckGo/searx backend refused connections; Google returned HTTP 429; Bing returned only unrelated 'Multichem' entities (Multichem Ltd UK, Multi-Chem Ltd Singapore, Multichem Poland, Multichem Group construction chemicals, Multichem Corporation India, Halliburton Multi-Chem) with no hit for 'Multichem Specialities Private Limited'; ZaubaCorp, TheCompanyCheck and InstaFinancials returned HTTP 403/404; MCA portal (mca.gov.in) returned HTTP 403. Therefore CIN, PAN (and its 4th-character holder type), GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered-office state and MCA status are all null - NOT public-verified, simply not retrieved. No audited accounts or official filings were located, so revenue FY25 and FY26 are null (not estimated). Role left as 'unknown': no evidence found distinguishing manufacturer from trader; the declared HS codes (300490 pharma formulations; 390599 other polymers of vinyl) are inconsistent with each other and with the claimed 'oil & gas / chemicals' industry, but per project rules an HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground - the code should be corrected to the actual one at verification. No rejection applied: there is no evidence the entity does not exist, is struck off, liquidated or bankrupt - the absence of data is a research gap, not a finding. Recommended next step: re-run with working search/registry access (MCA master data by name, GSTIN public search, Tofler/IndiaFilings) to confirm the exact legal name, CIN, PAN, GSTIN and state before any commercial decision.
